'''Glenn Roberts''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Fort Worth tournament]] on 2 June 2001 with Podracing/Mains/Jar Jar, according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2407">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-fort-worth-tx-6-2-01d2407/ fort-worth-tx-6-2-01], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-fort-worth-tx-6-2-01d2407/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
